Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.label: taken to a dyno bay
Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.text: Driven to a dyno bay for repair {PLACE}.

Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.label: ran on
Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.text: Could not stop {PLACE}: no brakes. It ran on and came to rest by itself.

Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.label: struck something
Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.text: Could not stop {PLACE}: no brakes. It ran on and struck {SUBJECT}.

Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.label: left behind
Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.text: Left standing {PLACE} when the last of its crew died. It waits there for whoever comes back for it.

Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.label: came down hard
Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.text: Came down hard {PLACE}, and stayed whole.

Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.label: taken
Phobos.Framework.Persistence.PhobosLogEn.text: Taken from {SUBJECT} by {WHO} {PLACE}. The logbook begins here.
